stories.title: Explainability Mapping Logic for Provider Signals
stories.description: Implement core logic to transform provider evaluation signals (credentials, verification links) into the standardized explainability schema, including source attribution (NPI, state boards), meaning interpretation, and limitations.

stories.title: Explainability Mapping Logic for Clinical Trial Signals
stories.description: Implement mapping of clinical trial signals (phase, status, eligibility) into explainability schema with clear user-facing meaning and limitations (e.g., recruitment status uncertainty, eligibility variability).

stories.title: Facade Integration of Explainability Layer
stories.description: Integrate explainability logic into evaluate_care_facade so that all evaluation responses consistently include explainability metadata before being returned to the tool router and LLM.

stories.title: API Contract Exposure for Explainability
stories.description: Extend FastAPI response models and tool outputs to include explainability schema fields, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and LLM tool-use responses.
